description: List apps in your AnyHook account with inbound URLs, sources, and destination URLs. Check isActive: an inactive app's inbound URL answers setup handshakes but acknowledges and discards event POSTs (202, reason app_inactive) instead of relaying them. Destination signing secrets are redacted to has_signing_secret plus a 4-char hint; a new secret in plaintext comes only from rotating it. An app whose slug was changed lists its former URLs under legacyInboundUrls; those still route to it.
name: anyhook_apps_list
title: List your AnyHook apps
